The issuer shows solid profitability (net margin ~21% and EBIT margin ~27%) and strong near-term liquidity (current ratio ~2.3x), indicating good operating performance and financial flexibility. Leverage is moderate (total liabilities ~53% of total assets), which limits the ability to reach the higher investment-grade categories. Overall, the profile aligns most closely with **BBB+**.

DECISION: BBB+
